scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Excellence in Sports Journalism
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of the State of Odisha
Applicant must not have been convicted of any criminal offence
Award can be conferred only once in the lifetime of the awardee for the concerned category
Award may be given posthumously to the next of kin of the selected awardee
Award may be cancelled and the amount recovered if obtained by fraudulent means
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹1,00,000 along with a statue, scroll, blazer with tie, and travel & dearness allowances.
